description: A timed plan of spoken cues for one talk. Produced by the generator, consumed by the runner, adjusted by the anchor matcher.

generatedBy.description: Provider that produced this plan (e.g. local, meta-model).

paceWpm.description: Speaking pace used for estimates, words per minute.

anchors.description: Distinctive phrases the speaker is likely to say near the START of this section. The matcher listens for these to locate the speaker.

atSecond.description: Absolute time from talk start when this cue should be spoken.

optional.description: Optional cues are dropped first when the speaker is running late.

text.description: The exact words spoken in-ear. Keep to a few words.

targetSeconds.description: Planned total talk length in seconds.

title: CuePlan
